interpretation: This is a historical proxy trial. It supports scarcity consolidation only if B's consolidation credits predict later reappearance in the recorded Stanford retrieval pool at least 0.10 better than matched yoked-shuffle C in the median seed, with a positive delta in at least 6 of 8 locked seeds. A rank-correlation relabel warning or excessive yoke fallback invalidates support.
limitations: Historical replay commits preserve retrieval order and content but not the original Stanford importance/recency scalars. The history tape therefore uses explicitly labelled neutral constants for those unavailable fields. A positive proxy result is permission for a better instrumented offline test, not permission to activate the live workspace.
